title: 第15章 卡点救援特殊体质第16章 御兽灵宝剑指林尘
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
想要什么，就不能问自己一句嘛？
又不是没有！
一个大男人，扭扭捏捏的。
大早上跑这么远，害得她连攻略奖励都没领。
【告知：气运之子-林尘，正在被佣兵团追杀逃亡】
【随机任务：卡点救援，经典的救援方式，让气运之子对你感恩戴德】
【卡点倒计时：00：00：59】
【奖励：随机特殊体质（蓝色~紫色品质）】
看着发布的任务信息，方玉凝蹙然皱眉。
只能说，真不愧是气运之子......
机缘走到哪儿都有，惹祸也是。
虽然这机缘，是她辛苦发育的。
当初采药时，方玉凝只感觉那边山谷间灵气浓郁，土壤肥沃。
她便尝试洒了些系统给的草种。
等到后来发现长势极好，方玉凝就将手上唯一的四品幻杀阵布置在了那边。
想着未来能抽到炼药之法，便有了一处发展资源。
没想到今天让林尘这傻孩子给找到了。
不过看系统提示，应该还有另一伙人在。
羊毛出在羊身上，林尘发现了不要紧。
要是旁人，那她就得宣誓一下主权了。

正好一肚子怨气没地方撒，方玉凝当即从不动山身上跳了下来。
随手从系统仓库掏出两张黄色字符。
【神行符】
【瞬息十里、绿色品质】
神行符品质不同，效果也不同。
她仓库里还有几张青色的，功效是瞬息百里。
一里五百米，十里就是五千米。
以她现在和林尘的距离，用上三五张足够了。
况且，这玩意她也只有三五张了。
地主家也没有余粮啊！
“身为气运之子，总该有点保命手段吧。”
喃喃自语着，方玉凝将护卫收回，随后捏碎符箓。
下一秒，她的身影便消失在原地。
轰隆！！！
另一边，林尘所在，随着一声巨响，大地震颤，山石滚落。
烟尘之中，一道身影窜出，周身赤红的火焰缭绕。
手上还提着个圆球。
仔细看去，竟是一颗大好的头颅。
那头颅的断口处，还有鲜血不断滴落。
“小尘子，咱们得赶紧跑，这状态撑不了多长时间。”

将手中头颅一甩，林尘大口的喘着粗气，随着身体不断调节，丝丝白气从他嘴角飘出。
气元劲，能够短暂提升自己身体的爆发力。
content_en:
Can't you just ask yourself what you want?
It’s not like there’s nothing!
A big man, coy.
After running so far so early in the morning, she didn't even receive the strategy reward.
[Information: Lin Chen, the son of destiny, is being chased by a mercenary group and is on the run]
[Random mission: stuck point rescue, a classic rescue method, let the son of luck be grateful to you]
[Stuck point countdown: 00:00:59]
[Reward: Random special physique (blue ~ purple quality)]
Looking at the mission information released, Fang Yuning frowned.
All I can say is that he is truly a child of luck...
Opportunities exist wherever we go, and so do disasters.
Although this opportunity was developed through her hard work.
When she first collected herbs, Fang Yuning only felt that the aura in the valley over there was rich and the soil was fertile.
She then tried spreading some grass seeds provided by the system.
When he later found out that it was growing very well, Fang Yuning placed the only fourth-grade phantom killing array in his hand there.
Thinking about how to refine medicine in the future, there is a development resource.
I didn't expect that this stupid kid Lin Chen would be found today.
But judging from the system prompts, there should be another group of people.
The wool comes from the sheep, it doesn't matter if Lin Chen discovers it.
If it were someone else, then she would have to declare her sovereignty.
Just as she had nowhere to vent her resentment, Fang Yuning immediately jumped off Fushan.
He casually took out two yellow characters from the system warehouse.
【Magic Talisman】
[Ten miles in a flash, green quality]
The quality of magical talismans is different, and the effects are also different.
She also has a few cyan ones in her warehouse, the effect is instantaneous.
One mile is five hundred meters, ten miles is five thousand meters.
With the current distance between her and Lin Chen, three or five cards were enough.
Besides, she only has three or five of these.
The landlord’s family has no surplus food!
"As a child of luck, you should have some means to save your life."
Muttering to himself, Fang Yuning took back the guard and then crushed the talisman.
The next second, her figure disappeared from the spot.
Boom! ! !
On the other side, where Lin Chen was, there was a loud noise, the earth trembled, and rocks rolled down.
A figure emerged from the smoke and dust, with red flames swirling around it.
There was also a round ball in his hand.
If you look closely, you can see that it is a big head.
There was blood dripping from the fracture of the head.
"Xiao Chenzi, we have to run quickly, we can't last long in this state."
Throwing the head in his hand, Lin Chen gasped for air. As his body continued to adjust, a trace of white air floated out of the corner of his mouth.
Qi Yuan Jin can temporarily increase the explosive power of one's body.
